title: An Approach to Ensure Fairness in News Articles
benchmark_measurement: Detection of biases related to religion in news articles, as part of a broader set of bias categories.
base_benchmarks: MBIC – A Media Bias Annotation Dataset
findings: The paper includes religion as one of several categories of bias (alongside gender, race, ethnicity, etc.) that its Dbias pipeline is designed to detect and mitigate. The framework is trained on a dataset where religious bias is one of the annotated types. However, the results are presented in aggregate for the overall bias detection and recognition tasks, and the paper does not provide specific performance metrics or findings for religious bias alone.
references: Julius A Adebayo and others. 2016. FairML: ToolBox for diagnosing bias in predictive modeling. Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
